question: What knowledge about Mañjughoṣa does Pārvatī request from Śaṃkara?
premises: Pārvatī asks Śaṃkara to tell her
Mañjughoṣa grants desired objects in the world
inference: Pārvatī requests Śaṃkara to tell her about Mañjughoṣa, who grants desired objects in the world.
plain_english: Tell me about Mañjughoṣa, who grants desired objects in the world.
